headline: Epic reportedly delays Disney game to lean further into AI development
summary: Epic Games reportedly delayed its Disney-licensed Marvel/Star Wars shooter so it could be developed using more AI, with developers apparently ordered to use AI for both code and asset creation, eliminating hand-written code and AI-free art.

claims.statement: Epic Games reportedly delayed its Disney-licensed video game so it could be made using more AI.
